item.simplefluidtanks.tank.tooltip_detai:
Use the §bwrench§r while §bsneaking§r to remove a tank from the multiblock structure.
§9Holds §9up §9to §b%d §9buckets §9of §9fluid.
item.simplefluidtanks.valve.tooltip_deta: Use the §bwrench§r on the valve to add new §btanks§r to the multiblock structure without loosing any fluid. Note that the valve counts as a §btank§r towards the total capacity and emits a redstone signal in conjunction with a §bcomparator§r.
item.simplefluidtanks.wrench.tooltip_det: Used to instantly dismantle §btanks§r and §bvalves§r. Also used to add new §btanks§r to the multiblock structure.
item.simplefluidtanks.portable_tank.tool:
Contents: %s%s(%s)
Amount: %s/%s
FillMode: %s
Hold §e§oshift§r for details.

Use to drain, use while §bsneaking§r to fill. Use while not looking at a block to change fill mode. Can pick up and place fluid source blocks.
§9Holds §9up §9to §b%d §9buckets §9of §9fluid.
config.buckets_per_tank.tooltip:
The amount of fluid one tank block can hold measured in buckets.
If this value is changed, all tanks already placed in the world need 
to be manually updated by right-clicking the valve with the wrench.
config.buckets_per_portable_tank.tooltip:
The amount of fluid one portable tank can hold measured in buckets.
Changing this value affects already existing portable tanks 
and may lead to loss of fluids if the value is lowered.
config.tank_block_destruction_time.toolt: The amount of time it takes to destroy the tank (-1 = indestructible).
config.valve_block_destruction_time.tool: The amount of time it takes to destroy the valve (-1 = indestructible).
